title: Block-device capability and abrupt-power evidence boundary
invariants: Capability discovery is evidence, not authorization.
Environment-dependent block-device capability may be AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE without weakening the contract.
An in-band hosted runner cannot prove observation of its own abrupt physical power cut.
Loopback and block-backed fsync evidence must not be promoted to device-controller or physical-power-loss proof.
Unavailable stronger evidence produces HOLD, never fabricated PASS.
Parent SYSTEM-009 exact head and receipt digest are pinned fail-closed.
